role: Political geography and election-information source — not a socioeconomic statistics substitute for Census/BLS/BEA/USDA.

documented_v2_resources.use: Contests, candidates, polling/early/dropoff locations, election administration for an address during supported elections
Political divisions / OCD identifiers by name or OCD ID

existing_reddirt_infrastructure.uses: GET /representatives (legacy — not in current v2 docs; re-verify before designing new pipelines)

privacy_rules: Never warehouse residential addresses solely to query civic geography.
Prefer controlled reference/sample addresses or privacy-preserving geographic methods.
Election coverage is time-bounded; do not treat responses as a permanent historical database.
design_rule: One source in the civic-data stack — not source of truth for everything. Cross with Census, BLS, FEC, journalism coverage, and turnout records.
